targeting.title: Copilot Not Showing in Outlook? Fix Classic, New and Mac
targeting.metaTitle: Copilot Not Showing in Outlook or Greyed Out
targeting.metaDescription: Copilot missing or greyed out in Outlook? Use the one-minute web test, then fix the real cause: license, the moved classic button, mailbox, Mac or settings.
targeting.excerpt: Why Copilot is missing or greyed out in classic Outlook, new Outlook, Outlook on the web and Outlook for Mac, checked against Microsoft's support and admin pages on 25 November 2026: a one-minute test that separates app problems from account problems, and the fix for each cause.
targeting.keywords: copilot not showing in outlook, copilot not showing in outlook classic, copilot greyed out in outlook, copilot button missing in outlook, copilot disappeared from outlook, why can't i see copilot in outlook, copilot not showing in new outlook, copilot icon missing outlook, draft with copilot not showing in outlook, copilot not showing in outlook mac, how to enable copilot in outlook classic, copilot not available in outlook
targeting.summary: Open Outlook on the web with the same account first: if Copilot appears there, the account works and the fault is in the Outlook app; if not, check the license, the mailbox and the admin settings|In classic Outlook the Copilot entry point is moving next to the ribbon in a rollout planned for mid to late November 2026, and the known issue that removed the buttons on build 20026.20182 and later is marked fixed|A Copilot icon that stays grey on every email usually means the mailbox is on a company Exchange server, and Schedule with Copilot, meeting prep and themes are not available in classic Outlook at all
targeting.author: Ali Rehman

siteAnalysis.source: docs/content-research/2026-11-25-inventory.json (read-only database query) and a Search Console export supplied privately by the owner on 23 November 2026. The export's click and impression figures are not reproduced in this repository.
siteAnalysis.finding: In the owner's Search Console export, problem-fix guides about AI buttons that do not appear are the posts that earn clicks: Gemini not showing in Docs or Gmail, Copilot in Excel not showing and Cursor stuck planning. Every Copilot query in the export was about Excel, so Copilot in the other Microsoft 365 apps had no page on the site. Autocomplete for Outlook returned the most distinct problem variants of the Microsoft 365 apps (classic, new, ribbon, greyed out, Mac, Draft with Copilot, disappeared).

searchConsole.reason: No Search Console API access in this workspace. The owner's export (three months to 23 November 2026) was read locally and kept out of the repository. No positions or volumes are stated anywhere.

siteAnalysis.cannibalization: Post 234 (Copilot in Excel not showing) covers Excel, the corner button of Word, Excel and PowerPoint, the license labels, channel, privacy and network checks; it never mentions Outlook. Post 68 (AI email assistants) is a tool roundup. Post 232 is GitHub Copilot in VS Code, a different product. No post covers Copilot in Outlook, Exchange mailboxes, classic versus new Outlook or Outlook for Mac. The new article keeps the generic checks short and links to post 234 for them.
